name: Perch
note: Strikes fast and sulks slow. Pinewatch water keeps it small and stubborn.

name: Carp
note: Bottom-feeder, says Ông. Patient fish for patient people.

name: Trout
note: Holds in the fast seam where the river forks. Flash of silver, gone.

name: Catfish
note: Whiskers find the bait before eyes do. Old Ba swears by the dusk bite.

name: Golden Koi
note: The one Ba chased for forty years. It looked at the camp, decided it was alright, and left.

name: Loach
note: A whisker of a fish, all mud and nerve. Old Ba could hook one blindfolded — he called them 'the river's little accountants'.
